Description.SourceString:
Once, this region was filled with cages, each containing one of the wondrous creatures that call Gielinor home. Some were even filled with beasts from other worlds, delivered via demon or Zamorakian sorcery.

It was a trophy, a symbol for others to see how powerful Dowdun Reach truly was. The wealthy families from the nearby village would be invited to gaze upon these creatures and encouraged to leave hefty donations in return.

Now, the cages either lie empty or have rotted away altogether, and the remaining creatures are the descendants of the beasts that ate all the others.
